name: Angela Hill
summary: A 30-fight UFC strawweight veteran (19-16, age 41) who beat Jingnan Xiong by decision in May after two decision losses. Twelve of her last fourteen fights went the distance.

how_they_fight.Striking: Muay Thai volume; five knockouts, none recent.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never knocked out; two submission losses, both in R1, early career.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Elite pace over three and five rounds.

keys_to_beat: Out-work her with power and takedowns

news.text: Added to UFC 335 against Shanelle Dyer.

sources.title: 30-fight UFC veteran added to Charles Oliveira and Alex Pereira's UFC 335 undercard
